user.title: Assist Learner
user.description: Pick the LLM conversation agent that unmatched requests should be forwarded to.

reconfigure.title: Change target agent
reconfigure.description: Pick the LLM conversation agent that unmatched requests are forwarded to. Learned sentences and commands are kept.

error.agent_not_found: That conversation agent was not found.
error.agent_is_self: The target cannot be Assist Learner itself.
error.agent_is_local: That is Home Assistant's own local agent. Pick your LLM agent (e.g. Claude); local sentences are already tried before Assist Learner when 'Prefer handling commands locally' is on.

abort.already_configured: Assist Learner is already set up.

data.retention_days: Raw request retention (days, 0 = delete after nightly run)

data.send_states_to_llm: Send current entity states to the LLM
data.rate_limit_per_minute: Max action runs per minute, per command
data.prefer_calling_device_player: Prefer the calling device's own player
data.llm_generalise: Ask the LLM to suggest richer templates for nightly proposals

areas.title: Preferred player per area
areas.description: Areas with several Music Assistant players. Area ids are shown as keys.

run_proposer.name: Run proposer
run_proposer.description: Turn logged LLM fallbacks into proposed local sentence templates now.

approve.name: Approve proposal
approve.description: Approve a pending proposal, optionally with an edited template.

reject.name: Reject proposal
reject.description: Reject a pending proposal; it will not be proposed again.

create_command.name: Create command
create_command.description: Create a draft custom command from a plain-English description.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Map of label to entity id (the allow-list).

generate_command.name: Generate command
generate_command.description: Ask the linked LLM to draft sentences and responses (regenerates with feedback).

decide_command.name: Decide command
decide_command.description: Approve, reject, enable or disable a command.

target_not_llm.title: Assist Learner forwards to a local agent
target_not_llm.description: Assist Learner's target agent is `{target}`, which is not an LLM, so unmatched requests just fail with "Sorry, I couldn't understand that" and nothing is learned. Go to Settings > Devices & services > Assist Learner > three-dot menu > Reconfigure and pick your LLM conversation agent.
